blocks.text: A subscription has an unsubscribe method. Calling it stops that subscription and runs the source cleanup.
Use a JavaScript or TypeScript project with RxJS 7 installed. Run imports through the project tool. Browser event examples need the stated HTML element. This site does not include RxJS in its runner.
Read the code step by step

items: `subscribe` registers a listener. For a stream or store that stays active, keep and use its cleanup handle.

blocks.text: Normally 0 and 1 appear before the subscription is stopped around 2.5 seconds.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Clean up long-lived subscriptions when their page part is removed. Do not rely on every source completing itself.
